Have questions as you apply?
We have answers.
Applying for a new job can be nerve-wracking.
Here are the answers to some common questions from future Team Members.
How do I apply for a job at a Chick-fil-A restaurant?
To apply for a job at a Chick-fil-A® restaurant, visit the employment opportunities page and enter your location to search for restaurants with opportunities near you.
How old do I have to be to work at a Chick-fil-A restaurant?
Hiring decisions are made by individual Chick-fil-A franchised Operators.

To see if you’re eligible for employment, please reach out to the hiring team at the location you are interested in to better understand qualifications and minimum age requirements to work at that restaurant.
How much will I get paid to work at a Chick-fil-A restaurant?
What benefits are available?
Chick-fil-A restaurants offer highly competitive wages that are often above minimum wage.

Because most Chick-fil-A restaurants are individually owned and operated by franchised Operators, each restaurant has its own unique compensation and benefits package that exemplify the care and appreciation Operators and other restaurant leaders have for their teams.
But the advantages of working at a Chick-fil-A restaurant go beyond wages and benefits.
All Chick-fil-A restaurants are closed on Sundays.

In addition, eligible Chick-fil-A Team Members can apply for college scholarships through the Remarkable Futures™ Scholarship program, and many are offered leadership and advancement opportunities at their local restaurant.
Please reach out to your local Chick-fil-A restaurant to learn more.
How can I check the status of my job application?
You can check the status of your submitted application by reaching out to the restaurant where you’ve applied.
How can I check which Chick-fil-A locations are hiring?
You can find new and existing job openings on the employment opportunities page or by contacting your local Chick-fil-A restaurant.
I’m having trouble submitting my application.
Who can help?
Please contact the restaurant where you’d like to apply for help submitting your job application.
What is life like as a Team Member?
Chick-fil-A Team Members consistently share that their restaurant is like a family.
Working in a Chick-fil-A restaurant offers the opportunity for teamwork and leadership development in a fast-paced environment.
Many Team Members are offered advancement at their local restaurant, college scholarships, community engagement opportunities, and more.
If you are looking for a fun, driven community that cares about impact, we would love for you to start your search for an opportunity near you.
